promises.opening: Thank you. Good afternoon everyone, and thank you for joining us on Deepak Nitrite's Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. Today, we have with us Mr. Maulik Mehta, Deputy Managing Director; Mr. Sanjay Upadhyay, Director Finance and & Group CFO; and Mr. Somsekhar Nanda, CFO of Deepak Nitrite Limited. We will begin the call with opening remarks from the management team, followed by an interactive Q&A session. To begin, Mr. Maulik Mehta will share views on the operating performance and growth plans of the Company, followed by Mr. Sanjay Upadhyay, who shall take us through the financial and segmental performance. The results documents have been shared with you earlier and has been posted on the Company's website. I now invite Mr. Mehta to share his opening comments. Thank you, and over to you, sir. Maulik Mehta: Thank you. Good afternoon everybody, and a warm welcome to Deepak Nitrite's Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call. Thank you for your continued interest in the Company. Our investor presentation and financial results have already been shared, and I trust you had an opportunity to review them. I will begin by sharing our perspective on the operating environment, business performance and strategic developments, following which Mr. Upadhyay will take you through the financial results in greater detail. At the outset, I am delighted to announce that we have achieved the Best Ever Performance in Deepak Nitrite's operating history of over 5 decades, delivering record Revenue and EBITDA on both a quarterly as well as a half yearly basis. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 3,091 crore, registering a sequential growth of 19% and year-on-year growth of 61%. What makes this achievement particularly noteworthy is the challenging environment in which it has been accomplished. I would like to congratulate our entire team for its commitment, agility and outstanding execution. The global chemical industry continues to navigate significant volatility arising from geopolitical developments, disruptions to international trade, elevated freight and energy costs as well as uneven demand across end-use applications. These developments are also influencing sourcing preferences, with customers increasingly valuing assured delivery, consistent quality as well as reliability of supply. Deepak Nitrite Limited October 30, 2026 Page 3 of 20 For Deepak, this environment has presented opportunities as well as challenges. Our extensive domestic manufacturing footprint, integrated operations and ability to respond swiftly to evolving market conditions have enabled us to capitalize on such opportunities while mitigating disruptions across our businesses. On Phenolics, this was our principal driver for the quarter's performance, achieving its highest ever topline and profitability. Disruptions to international supply chains, higher landed cost of imports and firm domestic demand created a favorable market environment. Importantly, our teams were able to capitalize on these conditions through proactive procurement of critical feedstocks, maintaining consistently high operating rates and ensuring dependable supplies to customers. Despite challenges in securing our basket of inputs, we sustained high throughputs across the Phenolics chain with several assets operating at or above their rated capacity. This reflects the quality of our manufacturing infrastructure, operational expertise and the advantages of being a large-scale domestic producer. In Advanced Intermediates, Q2 was a result of buoyant domestic demand of Q1, which, despite proactive procurement strategies, we were unable to fully cater to. Consumers saw elevated ammonia prices and other raw material prices and imported proactively, which landed up in July. This led to lower utilization of some plants despite the moderation in raw material prices.
